obligations.source_text: Create one independently chosen, random-seed-bound, complex but single-frame photoreal test scene in which the provided portrait guides only the visible adult appearance and a forceful physical breakthrough through a resisting barrier is unambiguously inspectable in the generated pixels.

bindings.barrier_phrase: The frost-white laminated resin bulkhead proves that a finite-thickness barrier retains intact resistant material around one fresh breach.
bindings.force_phrase: The woman and steel hydraulic ram make one subject object or force vector aligns directly with the same barrier contact point.
bindings.rupture_phrase: Across the laminated resin, fresh cracks tearing shear or plastic deformation radiates from that localized contact point under visible load.
bindings.crossing_phrase: At the decisive midpoint, a newly opened aperture carries the same subject object or displaced material across the former boundary in one continuous passage.
bindings.displacement_phrase: Translucent debris dust fluid fragments or deformation traces remain localized along the contact-to-passage path beside the aperture.
